owner_summaries.key_concerns: Entity-level TB balances are not zero, indicating potential reconciliation issues.
FX rates coverage does not meet policy, exposing the entity to currency risk.
Flux analysis exceptions are high, indicating potential misstatements or unusual transactions.
Gatekeeping block close flag is operational, ensuring process integrity.
Minimal open HITL cases, indicating effective case management.

residual_risks.description: Unbalanced TB balances may lead to inaccurate financial statements.

residual_risks.description: Non-compliance with FX rate coverage policy increases exposure to currency fluctuations.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance FX rate monitoring and ensure policy adherence through periodic audits.

residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Investigate exceptions and improve flux analysis thresholds.
